data.readme:
1. 新增支持 Switch 2 主机。
2. 修复 PS4 手柄断连问题。
3. 新增支持猎户座无线手柄。
data.readme_en:
1. Added support for Switch 2.
2. Fixed disconnection issue with PS4 controller.
3. Added support for Ultimate Wireless Controllers.

data.readme:
1. 修复 DualSense 手柄升级固件（0356）后无法连接的问题。
2. 新增支持 DualSense Edge 手柄。
data.readme_en:
1. Fixed the disconnection issue of the DualSense controller firmware version 0356 with the USB adapter.
2. Added support for DualSense Edge controller.

data.readme:
1. 修复 PS4 手柄断连的问题。
2. 新增支持 Lite 2 / Lite SE 手柄。
3. 修复在 PlayStation Classic 主机上无法连接手柄的问题。
4. 修复 Pro 2 手柄连接到 Switch 主机时无振动的问题。
5. 修复连接 PlayStation Classic 主机时按 HOME 键会有方向输出的问题。
6. 修复连接 PlayStation Classic 主机时 HOME 键无效的问题。
data.readme_en:
1. Fixed the disconnection issue with the PS4 controller.
2. Added controller support of Lite 2 & Lite SE.
3. Fixed the issue that unable to connect the controller to PSC console with other working modes of the adapter except PSC working mode.
4. Fixed the no vibration issue of the Pro 2 controller when connected to Switch console.
5. Fixed the issue that when press the home button on controller but shows the direction outputs on PSC console.
6. Fixed the invalid input of the home button on controller issue when connected to PSC console.

data.readme:
1. 修复 WiiU Pro 手柄摇杆异常的问题。
2. 修复 FC / NES / SNES / SFC Online 手柄连接异常的问题。
3. 调整启用 / 关闭配置组合键为 L3+R3+L1+R1（需要手柄最新固件）（原组合键为 L3 + R3）。
4. 新增 Dinput 模式支持扳机键同时输出模拟量和按键。
data.readme_en:
1. Fixed the abnormal joystick problem of Wii U Pro.
2. Fixed the connecting issue for FC/NES/SNES/SFC Online controllers.
3. Changed the custom profile from [L3+R3] to [L3+R3+L1+R1] for turn on/off(The latest firmware version needed).
4. D-input mode added for trigger analog and key output at the same time.

data.readme:
1. 修复 PS4 和 Switch Pro 手柄断连的问题。
2. 新增支持 Switch Online N64 / Online MD 蓝牙手柄。
data.readme_en:
1. Fixed connectivity issue with DualShock 4 and Switch Pro controller.
2. Added support for Switch Online N64 / Online MD Bluetooth controller.

data.readme:
1. 修复 PS3 手柄、Xbox 精英 2 手柄无震动的问题。
2. 修复 Switch 平台部分游戏震动异常问题。
3. 修复 Switch 平台部分游戏（如：怪物猎人：崛起）扳机键异常的问题。
4. 修复 WiiU Pro 手柄在 Xinput模式下 ZL、ZR 按键不起作用的问题。
5. 优化手柄连接的稳定性。
6. 支持八位堂 Pro2 蓝牙手柄。
data.readme_en:
1. Fixed the problem of no vibration for PS3 and Xbox Elite 2 controller.
2. Fixed the abnormal vibration of some games on Switch console.
3. Fixed the abnormal trigger problem of some games on Switch console (eg. Monster Hunter Rise).
4. Fixed the problem that the ZL and ZR buttons of the WiiU Pro controller have no work on Xinput mode (PC console).
5. Improved the stability of the controller connection.
6. Supported 8BitDo Pro2 Bluetooth controller.

data.readme:
1. 适配八位堂精英软件，可通过精英软件对手柄按键映射、摇杆灵敏度、扳机键灵敏度、振动强度以及宏指令等功能进行自定义配置。（仅限 PS4、PS5、Switch Pro、Xbox One S/X 蓝牙手柄）。
2. 适配 PS5（DualSense）手柄。
data.readme_en:
1. Added support for 8BitDo Ultimate Software: customize button mapping, adjust stick & trigger sensitivity, vibration power control and create macros.(PS5, PS4, Xbox One S/X and Switch Pro controllers only).
2. Added support for DualSense Controller.

data.readme:
1. 新增支持 SN30 Pro for Android 手柄。
2. 新增恢复出厂设置功能，按住配对键 5 秒至指示灯熄灭。
3. 新增支持 Arcade Stick (3 代) 街机摇杆。

注意: 手动切换模式后会停用自动识别，可通过恢复出厂设置重新启用，此操作会清除已配对的手柄。
data.readme_en:
1. Added support for SN30 Pro for Android gamepad.
2. Press and hold the pair button about 5 seconds until the LED was off for retore factory settings.
3. Added support for 8BitDo Arcade Stick (3th generation).

Tip: After manually switching the mode, automatically recognition will be disabled. It can be re-enabled by restoring the factory settings. The restoring operation will clear the paired information.

data.readme: 1. 优化在 Switch 主机使用的自动识别功能。
data.readme_en: 1. Enhanced the automatic recognition on Switch console.

data.readme:
1. 增加支持 Xbox One 精英手柄二代、八位堂 Zero 2。
2. 修复 Dinput 模式下，Xbox One 手柄和 Xbox One 精英手柄二代的 A-B、X-Y 按键映射错误的问题。
3. 修复偶尔出现的八位堂蓝牙手柄无法连接的问题。
4. 修复 Xbox One 手柄升级固件后，连接上按键无响应的问题。
5. 修复 Dinput 模式下，按 Xbox One / PS4 / Switch Pro 手柄 Home 键异常的问题。
6. 修复 Mac 模式在 macOS Catalina 系统下引起键鼠卡顿的问题。
7. 修复连接 WiiU Pro、M30 蓝牙手柄按键异常的问题。
data.readme_en:
1. Added support for Xbox One Elite 2 and 8BitDo Zero 2.
2. Fixed the button mapping issue for A/B and X/Y for Xbox One & Xbox One Elite 2 on D-input mode.
3. Fixed the connectivity issue with 8BitDo Bluetooth controllers.
4. Fixed the compatibility issue with Xbox One after its firmware update.
5. Fixed the HOME button issue on PS4 / Xbox One / Switch Pro on D-input mode.
6. Fixed the issue of mouse/keyboard getting stuck randomly on Mac mode running on macOS Catalina.
7. Fixed the button issues on WiiU Pro and 8BitDo M30 bluetooth controller.

data.readme:
1. 增加: 支持SEGA Genesis Mini & Mega Drive Mini主机。（切换热键: DPAD_LEFT+DPAD_UP+SELECT）
2. 修复: 《火焰之纹章：风花雪月》游戏在switch主机上震动异常的问题。
data.readme_en:
1. Added support for SEGA Genesis Mini & Mega Drive Mini.(Enter hotkey: DPAD_LEFT+DPAD_UP+SELECT)
2. Fixed the abnormal vibration problem of the game "Fixed Fire Emblem: ThreeHouses" on switch console.

data.readme:
1. 修复: 当 Wii/Wii Mote手柄震动时按键不正常的问题。
2. 修复: JoyCons没有L3 R3的问题。
3. 修复: 《火焰之纹章：风花雪月》游戏在switch主机上震动异常的问题。
4. 修复: 调节震动级别快捷键由L1+R1+SELECT(PS4:SHARE)改为L2+R2+SELECT(PS4:SHARE), 以避免跟Switch游戏复位快捷键冲突。
data.readme_en:
1. Fixed the Wii/Wii Mote controller abnormal button problem when vibration happens.
2. Added L3 and R3 for JoyCons.
3. Fixed the abnormal vibration problem of the game "Fire Emblem: ThreeHouses" on switch console.
4. Changed vibration levels adjust hot key from  L1+R1+SELECT(PS4:SHARE) to L2+R2+SELECT(PS4:SHARE), it would avoid conflicts with the game reset hot key.

data.readme: 1. 修正 《古惑狼三部曲》和《古惑狼赛车》游戏在Switch主机中震动异常的问题。
data.readme_en: 1. Fixed the abnormal vibration problem of "Crash Bandicoot N.Sane Trilogy" and "Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled" on switch console.

data.readme: 1. 修正: 《生化危机启示录2（Resident Evil Revelations 2）》和《喷射战士2》（Splatoon 2）在Switch主机中震动异常的问题。
data.readme_en: 1. Keep only one SWITCH mode for NS test. (WARNING: Other modes has been removed, so you can't use the adaptor on the other console)

data.readme: 1. 修复在连接Switch主机一段时间后会出现异常的问题。
data.readme_en: 1. Fixed the connection interruption or the console exception after a period of connection on NS.
